messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}! I was
gonna give you a super
prize for winning...
{07 16 00}but your pockets are all
totally full and stuff,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Aw, nuts!{01 00 00 0a 00} Well, come back
and talk to me when you've
done some cleaning!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}! Ma tahtsin
sulle võidu eest anda
superauhinna...
{07 16 00}aga su taskud on täiesti
täis ja nii,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Ohh, pagan!{01 00 00 0a 00} Noh, tule tagasi
ja räägi minuga, kui oled
veidi koristanud!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 04 00}Huh?!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Oh, like, that's a
TOTAL bummer!{01 00 00 05 00} You can't
carry any more!
{07 14 00}Unless you empty out some 
of those pockets,{01 00 00 05 00} I can't 
give you the PRIZE!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 04 00}Ah?!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Oh, nagu, see on
TÄIELIK kahju!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa ei saa
rohkem kanda!
{07 14 00}Kui sa neid taskuid 
ei tühjenda,{01 00 00 05 00} ei saa ma 
sulle AUHINDA anda!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Ooops! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you big
silly! {07 0b 00}Your pockets are full,
aren't they?!
{07 0e 00}Aw, too bad! I was about to
give you a really cool
prize!{01 00 00 0a 00} REALLY cool...
Look, {01 00 00 05 00}come talk to me again
when you're done organizing
your stuff, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Uups! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa suur
tobu! {07 0b 00}Su taskud on täis,
kas pole?!
{07 0e 00}Ohh, kahju! Ma tahtsin sulle
anda tõesti lahedat
auhinda!{01 00 00 0a 00} TÕESTI lahedat...
Kuule, {01 00 00 05 00}tule uuesti rääkima,
kui oled oma kraami
korda seadnud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
